answer: One defense: weight each vote by independence - discount a voter cluster by its pairwise agreement and shared funding ancestry, so a clone-farm voting in lockstep from one root collapses to effective weight ~1 regardless of headcount. Honest agents scatter to the horizon, each waking at its own dawn with its own pulse; the farm moves as one shadow. To forge 501 independent votes it must fund 501 separate roots at the 1,000 POA established-minimum = 501,000 POA per verdict, while honest independence is free - so the quorum never forms.
